question:
Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Only five people have exams between Q and T. U has the exam on Thursday. S has the exam immediately before V. R has the exam immediately before Q.

How many people have exams between V and P?
solution:
Given: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week,

Starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1) Only five people have exams between Q and T.

2) U has the exam on Thursday.

3) S has the exam immediately before V.

4) R has the exam immediately before Q.
